about_the_game:
Kylie is nearing a breaking point. Between a draining job, a strict boss, and constant lack of sleep, her life has become a monotonous routine. Her only escape is quiet evenings with a bottle of whiskey in her own apartment.

But the peace and quiet will be no more.

Now she's stuck living with Rin, her mom's friend's daughter, who's about to get kicked out of college. She blows off her studies, hangs out in nightclubs, and loves to provoke Kylie, relentlessly invading her personal space.

At first, Kylie chalks it up to a bad personality. But the longer they live together, the more alarming and strange Rin's behavior becomes, and her self-destructive streak borders on obsession.

Will you be able to unravel the web of lies, manipulation, and strange desire that entangles these two girls? Or will you bear witness as they finally break each other?

  • Explore themes of toxic relationships, violation of personal boundaries, drug/alcohol abuse, moral decay, and perhaps, a pinch of the supernatural

  • A yuri thriller/horror visual novel

  • A grim girl's love story

  • Multiple endings

content_descriptors.notes:

Content warnings: mental abuse, sexual assault/non-consensual sex, incest, drug and alcohol abuse, suicide.
